title: Preflight verification matrix + automated gating for releases
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Define and implement a standardized preflight verification matrix (the 'preflight-runner') that runs automatically prior to major releases, canary rollouts, and LTS upgrades. The matrix should include smoke tests, critical integration checks, perf regression gates (tail-latency and throughput), and a small deterministic eval suite for quality/regression detection. It must be pluggable into CI/CD, surface results in Console, and support auto-block/auto-rollforward policies for different release channels (canary, stable, LTS).

Why: Currently release validation is ad-hoc across teams; we've had two incidents in the last 6 months where perf regressions slipped through canary due to inadequate tail-latency checks. Standardizing preflight reduces manual review load, shortens release cycles, and creates a reproducible audit trail for Private and Dedicated customers.

Scope and high-level requirements:
- Implement a "preflight-runner" service and a runner step in our release pipeline that executes the verification matrix and returns a structured report.
- Matrix components:
  - Smoke & API sanity tests (end-to-end minimal queries for text, chat, embeddings) against canary/preview cluster.
  - Integration tests for KV cache correctness and stateful session continuity.
  - Perf microbench: synthetic token-generation tests (1-512 seq distribution) measuring p50/p95/p99 latency and throughput under configured load.
  - Tail-latency probe under production-like batching patterns.
  - Deterministic eval suite: 100 prompts across core use-cases (summarization, Q&A, code, embeddings) with automated scoring and failure thresholds.
  - Upgrade path checks for Private (rolling upgrade smoke) verifying KMS/HSM connectivity and DB migrations.
- Gate behavior by channel:
  - Canary: allow soft-fail logging for low-severity eval deltas but fail on perf regressions >10% p99 or functional failures.
  - Stable/LTS: stricter thresholds (<=5% perf delta, no functional/eval regressions allowed), require manual approval if any gate trips.
- Integrations: CI (GitHub Actions), Console (preflight run summary + per-test links), Alerting (PagerDuty for high-severity failures), and release orchestration (auto-block and create rollback PR when configured).

Acceptance criteria:
1) Preflight-runner runs as a pipeline step and produces a JSON report stored as an artifact.
2) Perf gates implemented: p50/p95/p99 comparisons against baseline, configurable thresholds per release channel.
3) Deterministic evals run deterministically with fixed seeds and produce quality delta metrics; baseline artifacts stored.
4) Console shows the last preflight result per release with pass/fail and links to logs/PRs.
5) Playbook for manual override and gated rollout documented in Confluence.

Minimal rollout plan:
- Discovery + matrix design (this ticket) — Done (design doc in Confluence).
- Implement preflight-runner prototype (ENG) — current sprint.
- Wire to CI and run against next canary (QA).
- Iterate thresholds based on 2 weeks of canary telemetry.
- Gate as enforced for stable/LTS releases after one iteration.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Running the full matrix adds time to pipelines; compromise by parallelizing smoke/perf/eval stages and caching baselines.
- Deterministic eval suite may produce noisy signal for some models — keep suite small and focused initially.
- Strict LTS gates may slow releases; provide opt-in exemptions with documented risk acceptance for emergency patches.
